title: 1.5 Graphs of Sine and Cosine Functions

icans: I can find the amplitude and period of a sine or cosine function.
I can describe phase shifts and vertical shifts.
I can sketch a sine or cosine graph and write its equation.

vocab: |a|, half the ___________ between the maximum and minimum of y = a sin bx
the __________ of one cycle: 2π/b for y = a sin bx
the _____________ shift c/b of y = a sin(bx − c)

blocks.p: Graph y = a sin(bx − c) + d with sliders.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: y = a sin(bx − c) + d: amplitude = |a|, period = _______________.
